summary: Comprehensive testing of Plan Comparison, Feature Gating, Monthly Customization Credits, and Super Admin Feature Overrides completed. All backend APIs (13/13) passed. Frontend UI features verified including Plans tab, Feature Override Modal, and Feature Gating warning.

critical_code_review_comments: All 4 features implemented correctly: Plan Comparison, Feature Gating, Monthly Customization Credits, Super Admin Feature Overrides
Backend APIs properly handle plan changes, customization credits, and feature overrides
Frontend Plans tab displays all plan information correctly with proper styling
Feature Override Modal provides full control over tenant features and limits
Feature gating warning correctly shows in Admin Panel Reports tab when enhanced_reports is disabled
Note: Feature gating warning is in Admin.js (/admin route), not in TenantDashboard.js (main dashboard)
